decisions.statement: The folder is named the plural a page type gathers its pages under.
A folder named no page type's plural is refused before anything else is read.
Every page here is of that page type or of a page type extending it.
Every page here names the page above as the collection holding that page.
The page above is named by its page type and slug together.
A folder above holding no page of its own is refused.
The page above answering with two addresses is held by the one the pages here name.
A page here carries what that page holds in a file beside it.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside one is refused.
A folder gathering no page at all is refused.
A folder sitting inside is judged where that folder is.

definition: the shape of a folder gathering under a plural the parts of the collection above
